show.description: Betrayed and left for dead by his best friend , Grandmaster Arjun resurfaces as a memory-impaired janitor for a struggling fight club. His legendary instincts return as he defends his new family against the Solanki clan , eventually regaining his memory during a high-stakes championship. Arjun exposes the traitors who stole his throne , defeats the mastermind Agastya , and reclaims his title as the rightful Fighter Champion
